recommendation: Use FHIR-53185 or another FHIR-I/Security work-group review to decide current R6 wording after the API Incubator $meta, $meta-add, and $meta-delete definitions are published and stable. If the original FHIR-20630 intent still applies, update source/resource/resource-notes.xml#tag-updates with valid links to those published operation definitions rather than reintroducing resource-operation-meta.html.
issue_request: FHIR-20630 asked the BaseResource Resource.html#tag-updates guidance to reference the $meta operations so clients had fuller support for handling meta/tag updates; Jira status is Published and resolution is Persuasive.
initial_application: Commit 33ef5f515ec36018d09d933b30e47d0cce23a982, submitted via PR 1934, added a sentence to source/resource/resource-notes.xml saying clients can retrieve current tags using the Resource $meta operation.
additional_context: Resource remains active/normative current-build source. R6 cleanup commit 270e0ceb7b029dad4ca0fc5ccf5296ff370888cd removed the FHIR-20630 sentence, deleted the core Resource.$meta/$meta-add/$meta-delete OperationDefinition files, and removed them from the Resource operation list. The ballot intro says these operations moved to the API Incubator, but the linked operation pages returned 404 and HL7/api-incubator-ig currently contains only incoming meta examples, not operation definitions. FHIR-53185 is a later Triaged/Unresolved R6 request to mention $meta-add and $meta-delete in the same section.
reconciliation: Published an empty human-review audit commit. No source change was made because restoring the removed core link would be broken, while adding a new external API Incubator reference would be premature while the target operation definitions and the current R6 tracker remain unresolved.

related_jiras.note: Related Security concern about special update handling was retracted/no-change; Security minutes recommended closing it by FHIR-20630.

Already represented on the combined branch; explains the current Meta table wording about other FHIR operations that impact meta, but does not settle whether tag-updates should link to moved meta operations.
